GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India revenue split could not be read: nbcbearings.com returned a Radware bot-challenge page ('Verifying your browser before proceeding'), and registry/financial aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. web_search was unavailable during this run (searx connection refused), so no tender or GST page could be located. Domestic turnover: null — not public in the sources reachable here.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs rows with destination (United States), HS codes (84822090 taper roller bearings, 84825000 cylindrical roller bearings) and bill-of-lading numbers (1110043, 1133286, 1114934, 1110045) on 2026-02-28, plus recurring buyer entities in Nepal (Singhi Traders), Sri Lanka (NBC Bearings Lanka) and Mexico (Conmet de Mexico) indicating a standing export book. Declared HS 848210 (ball bearings) does not match the observed rows, which are 84822090/84825000 (taper and cylindrical roller bearings); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be recorded as 84822090 / 84825000 (roller bearings), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is a mismatch: the shipment descriptions show bearings manufacturing (auto/industrial components), not metals or mining. PAN AAACN9969L and state Jharkhand were not verified here (registries out of scope for this role); the customs address on file is Khatipura Road, which is Jaipur, Rajasthan — the Jharkhand attribution is unconfirmed. Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than none_found: absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation (403/bot-block), not proof of no domestic sales. No figures invented; turnover and export value are null.
